typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
Interface for methods used for starting a job to process/interpret many {@link MlModel}s, ex: {@link MlSubject.ProcessJob} and {@link MlSubject.InterpretJob}.
Methodology for defining a batch:
- subjects are fetched/filtered and are assigned to one or more routes, via routing logic
- each route is executed in a separate batch, combining all of its assigned subjects
- a given route may participate in more than one batch, if it has many subjects assigned to it - see {@link MlSubject.OperationJobSpec#batchSize}
- a given route may also participate in more than one batch, if the time range is large - see {@link MlSubject.OperationJobSpec#batchInterval}
- the route defines the model and output handlers to be used for the batch

Note: batching in this manner maximizes the number of subjects processed in a single model execution call.
name: MlSubject.OperationJob
